title: phlox pilosa subsp. longipilosa
intro: Phlox pilosa subsp. longipilosa, commonly known as downy phlox, is a perennial flowering plant belonging to the phlox family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of downy phlox include pain relief, wound healing, and antiseptic effects, making it a valuable remedy for various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
